text:
Rae: Quick sticky thread for a compact webinar idea — target: product + infra engs, 30-40m, very tactical. Working title idea: 'ServeSmart Sprint: practical cost-savvy inference patterns'. feedback?
Luis: I like the sprint framing. promises action items people can ship in a week. keep it practical not academic.
Jin: propose format: 5m framing + 15m demo playbook + 8m customer micro-case + 7-10m q&a. tight but punchy.
Rae: agreed. need 2 presenters: one for the demo playbook (Jin?) and one host/ops checklist (Hannah).
Jin: yes I'll do demo. plan to show baseline -> apply batching -> add prefix cache -> route cheap quant variant. each step show delta.
Hannah: I'll own host scripts, checklist slide, and the downloadable one-pager. also volunteer to run follow-up nurture.
Rae: rehearsal windows Mon/Wed 11-12 PT and Thu 15-17 PT. which works?
Luis: Wed 11 works for me.
Jin: Wed 11 for tech check, Thu 15 for full run? want 2 rehearsals.
Hannah: both work. I'll set invites.
OpsBot: Rehearsal placeholders created: Wed 11:00 PT (tech check), Thu 15:00 PT (full run). Calendar links sent.
Rae: event page copy needs: 1-line hook, 2-sentence blurb, 3 TL;DR bullets, 2 CTA buttons. Luis can you draft?
Luis: will draft 3 headline variants by EOD. pref variants that include a measurable benefit line e.g., 'Cut token spend fast'.
Jin: demo assets: I'll put a reproducible notebook + short screen capture in the drive. will include a 90s prerecorded fallback clip that shows final outputs.
Hannah: follow-up email idea: recording + checklist + "Request a free cost review" CTA. also include a small form to capture model usage patterns.
Rae: good. For the live Q&A, let's prepare 3 canned questions and one audience poll: "Which is your top pain point? (cost / latency / reliability)"
Luis: I'll make the poll and two social CTAs (LinkedIn+X). Also suggest we A/B test two headlines on the event page.
Jin: technical ask for rehearsal: demo must pin model versions and have a fallback to quantized variant. snippet I will use: `export MODEL_ID=model-rc1 && curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"'$MODEL_ID'","input":"hello"}'`
Hannah: host cue cards: intro, quick value bullets, handoff phrasing to demo, closing CTAs. I'll draft and share.
Rae: assets to collect before tech check: 1) Draft landing page copy 2) CTA variants (Luis) 3) Demo notebook + fallback video (Jin) 4) Presenter cue cards + checklist (Hannah).
Luis: got it. Also think about a short pre-event snippet (20s) we can use in social to highlight the 1-line stat.
Jin: can confirm we have a sanitized stat: internal pilot saw ~28% token cost reduction with caching+batching at steady traffic. ok to use?
Rae: yes use "~28%" phrasing. avoid exact customer name until we have permission.
OpsBot: Recording policy reminder: if customer appears, confirm release signed 72 hours pre-event.
Hannah: noted. I'll follow up with BE for release status.
Rae: final run-of-show draft (times are max):
0:00 - 0:45 Welcome & agenda (Rae)
0:45 - 5:00 Quick customer highlight (pre-recorded clip or N/A)
5:00 - 20:00 Demo playbook: baseline -> batching -> caching -> routing (Jin)
20:00 - 28:00 Ops checklist + deploy notes + downloads (Hannah)
28:00 - 36:00 Live Q&A + poll (All)
Hannah: I'll prepare a slide with fallback GIFs and the 90s video link visible during demo.
Luis: CTA variants incoming. will post copy in this thread when ready.
Jin: uploading demo artifacts to drive now. link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/serve-smart-xxx
Rae: perfect. next steps: Luis posts CTAs, Jin uploads notebook + fallback, Hannah sends calendar invites + cue cards. reconvene at tech check. :rocket:
